gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-montagu-slab: Expressive and loud, Snowburst One cuts its letters like a stencil. Montagu Slab, a serif, follows with sturdy downstrokes and slender turns, and a large x-height that keeps a long page easy going.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-serif-henta: Snowburst One is a stencil display face with wide bridges and tall lowercase, set against a classic serif whose strokes barely vary. Its quiet modulation lets the heading do the shouting.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-ovo: Authoritative is the feel of Ovo, a classic serif with tall middle bands and thin strokes only slightly lighter than its stems. And Snowburst One, stencilled and bold, gives that steadiness something to push against.
gen-gf-tektur-fs-bespoke-slab: Bespoke Slab reads grounded and refined, a serif with tall bodies in every lowercase letter. Bespoke Slab would swallow Tektur's laser-etched lines if the heading were made small, so give that trace some room.
gen-gf-tektur-fs-hoover: Hoover is a refined, robust serif with a generous entry into the e and compressed ascenders. And Tektur, drawn like pipe cleaner in every letter, gives it a lively, expressive header.
gen-gf-tektur-fs-trench-slab: Trench Slab is a dignified serif with almost no gap between lowercase and capitals. Tektur's cut-out strokes, like a router bit tracing fixed-width lines, set it off with a distinctive, expressive heading.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-domine: Domine, a classic serif, keeps its ascenders compact above tall lowercase and leaves breathing space inside each curve. Tektur's single-width strokes above it make long lines feel crisp rather than crowded.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-esteban: Quirky tech meets old-world type. Tektur's one-width strokes sit opposite Esteban, a serif whose thin strokes stay close to its thick ones, and that gentle contrast is the pair's best trait.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-faustina: Faustina reads classic and authoritative, its bowls thinning gracefully and its c opening like a pair of pliers. Tektur then sets a thick-only outline above that quiet text serif, and the two stay distinct.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-halant: Tektur is a thread of ink, with no swelling or tapering, wide terminal openings and outsized lowercase. But Halant, a text serif with outward-pointing terminals and a towering x-height, reads as a steady, traditional voice across paragraphs.
